note: Token coins boxed in full-resolution frame pixels (x0, y0, x1, y1) on frames of the Pineapple Patch pickup windows in var/incidents/*-token (frames 45 and 100 of each). 'eye': drawn by eye from contact sheets and full-res crops, 2026-09-27/28. 'review': a coin the detector found that the eye had missed, confirmed on a crop (and 'sure': false where the crop could not settle it -- those are left out of training both ways). Kinds are descriptive, not the game's names. Frames marked 'partial' come from other fields' gather snapshots (var/routes): only the boxes the detector flagged were reviewed there -- 'coins' are the ones that were coins, 'not_coins' the ones that were not, and nothing else on such a frame is known.
